proof:
In rational R^3 with coordinates (t,x,y), let H be the t-axis and let the three complete saturated two-planes have normal directions v1=(0,1,0), v2=(0,0,1), v3=(0,-1,-1). They pairwise intersect exactly in H and v1+v2+v3=0. Give each plane weight1. In primitive page coordinates (t,s), set gamma_i=|t|+|s| and f_i=H(t)+H(s), where H(z)=z^2/2 for |z|<=1 and H(z)=|z|-1/2 outside. The restrictions agree on H, f-gamma lies in [-1,0], and the common ambient support H'(t0)(t-t0)+H(t0) at every (t0,0,0), together with ordinary page convexity, proves printed PC on every inherited rational carrier. The reference has the analogous common support and strictly positive recession.

On every page take the SAME three rational primal samples A={(0,0),(1,0),(1/2,1/4)} with actual heights 0,1/2,5/32. Define E_A=conv{(a,f_i(a)):a in A}+epi(|t|+|s|), and let F_i be its lower boundary. The entire primal argument in whole old289 proves F_i>=f_i, finite REAL PA on rational spatial geometry, same recession and bounded relative error. The affine form L(t,s)=t/2-3s/8 takes exactly these three heights, and its gradient (1/2,-3/8) is inside the recession dual square [-1,1]^2. Thus it supports E_A and equals F_i on the whole sample triangle. Along H, the same page construction gives an identical entire trace on all three pages. On 0<=t<=1 that trace is t/2, by the supporting inequality L(t,0) and the segment between the first two lifts. Hence the F_i glue continuously, match all shared samples exactly and approximate each convex branch from above.

At z=(1/2,0,0), take endpoints z+(1/8)v_i. Each lies in its sample triangle, has F value 1/4-3/64=13/64, and the equal-weight barycenter is z, whose value is 1/4=16/64. A rational common refinement makes the H segment a face of each sample triangle, so this is a legal printed PCC with cost -3/64. The glued function is NOT PC. This is an exact failure of naive per-cell/page primal interpolation for dependent normal pages, despite agreement of the entire shared trace and exact sampled values. It is not a counterexample to regularizability: it only refutes this gluing shortcut. No MA is assigned to this failed approximant. New294 supplies a different common-dual construction.
